direction: Create a sleek, modern isometric tech illustration with soft volumetric lighting and gentle ocean mist. Use only the brand hues—tide teal (#0e7490), deep sea blue (#164e63), and sea foam (#ecfeff)—with neutrals for balance. Mood is calm, reliable, and “always in sync,” avoiding clutter. Composition should feel clean and engineered: crisp edges, subtle gradients, and light reflections like water on metal. No text, letters, logos, or watermarks anywhere.

attempts.prompt: folder-to-S3 sync flow in an isometric view: a small open folder icon on the left sending glowing data packets along a curved cable of sea-foam light toward a distant simplified S3 bucket-like container on the right (no text). A soft tide-teal glow pulse travels across the path, implying resumable uploads. Background: dark deep-sea blue with faint ocean-mist gradient. Leave the entire center area clean for clear focal framing, no text or symbols. Cinematic lighting, crisp edges.
